title: Infernos
description: All the mods needed for the infernos server.
body:
All the mods needed for the infernos server. The majority focus is on techy/science based mods and graphics enhancing mods.

Some of the mods you'll find in this pack include:

- Mekanism and Applied Energistics (with all their additions)
- Ars Nouveau
- Better mod collection
- CC: Tweaked
- Discord Integration
- Embeddium and Oculus (for shaders and graphics optimizations)
- QoL based mods
- Performance enhancing mods
- Tempad and Waystones

I hope you enjoy!

For info on joining the server join our Discord: https://discord.gg/QdmUq3XvUj

(Server is based in South Africa)
